T:P1.1.text: Innovative Industrial Packaging That Moves the World | Greif

T:P1.2.text: Greif is an industrial packaging products and services leader with a vision to be the best performing customer service company in the world.

T:P1.3.text: Greif is a global leader in industrial packaging products and services, striving to be the advantage that helps our customers win.

T:P1.4.text: Greif is committed to partnering with you to provide a comprehensive and innovative product portfolio to protect and safely transport customers' products worldwide.

T:P1.5.text: Greif is unwavering in its commitment to the wise use of financial, natural, and human resources to afford future generations the ability to meet their needs.

T:P1.6.text: At Greif, your work has purpose, colleagues care about your well-being and you have the opportunity to grow and thrive. Service and leadership are the core of everything we do.

T:P1.7.text: Creating packaging solutions for life's essentials.

T:P1.8.text: Greif is a global leader in industrial packaging products and services — pursuing its vision to be the best customer service company in the world.

T:P1.9.text: Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums, intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty products.

T:P1.10.text: We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States. Greif is strategically positioned in multiple countries to serve customers of all sizes and needs.

T:P1.11.text: These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

T:P1.12.text: Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities

T:P1.13.text: By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets 97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills.

T:P1.15.text: Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

T:P1.16.text: Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products

T:P1.17.text: Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

T:P1.19.text: Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work and is committed to maintaining gender pay parity.

T:P1.20.text: Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers

T:P1.21.text: By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can have a greater impact across its value chain.

C:P1.1.text: Kadant Inc. - A Global Leader in Technology And Engineered Systems

C:P1.2.text: Kadant Inc. is a global supplier of high-value, engineered systems used in process industries worldwide.

C:P1.3.text: A Global Leader in Technology & Engineered Systems that Drive

C:P1.4.text: We are a global supplier of technologies and engineered systems that drive Sustainable Industrial Processing®. Our products and services play an integral role in enhancing efficiency, optimizing energy utilization, and maximizing productivity in process industries.

C:P1.5.text: Custom-engineered products, systems, and technologies used to enable fluid, power, and data transfer to optimize energy utilization, improve machine runnability, and enhance productivity.

C:P1.6.text: Machinery and engineered systems and components to help customers maximize the production of fiber-based, renewable products.

C:P1.7.text: Products and systems used to handle bulk and discrete materials for secondary processing.

C:P1.8.text: From paper and packaging to wood products, mining, food processing, and energy, Kadant delivers engineered systems and technologies purpose-built for the demands of global process industries. Explore how our expertise and solutions are put to work across the markets we serve.

C:P1.9.text: Explore our family of companies to learn how each one delivers specialized expertise and proven solutions to process industries around the world.

C:P1.10.text: Our products are designed to reduce waste, use resources more efficiently, and allow our customers to create more value with fewer inputs. We do this with integrity, a commitment to ethics, and responsible operations.

C:P1.11.text: Kadant's automation portfolio — illumen.X, PaperFront®, and Vayeron Asset Performance Monitoring — gives process industries the digital tools to optimize performance, predict equipment failures, and build data-driven operations from plant floor to enterprise.

C:P1.12.text: We work to envision the future and create value through discovering and applying innovations that address industrial processing challenges while extending our depth of technology.

C:P2.2.text: Our Flow Control segment consists of our Fluid Handling and Doctoring, Cleaning & Filtration product lines, delivering custom-engineered products, systems, and technologies that keep critical industrial and commercial processes running efficiently across packaging, tissue, food processing, metals, and other demanding sectors.

C:P2.3.text: Our brand portfolio carries a rich heritage of product innovation with well-known industry names including AES, Johnson, Lodding, Unaflex, and Vickery. Our primary products include rotary sealing devices, steam systems, expansion joints, doctor systems, roll and fabric cleaning devices, and filtration and fiber recovery systems. With deep application expertise and a proven track record, we help customers reduce energy consumption, improve machine runnability, and build long-term operational sustainability.

C:P2.5.text: Kadant’s fluid handling products and technologies are used to control the flow of fluids in process industries worldwide. These products include rotary joints and unions, expansion joints, condensate pumps, thermocompressors, desuperheaters, and direct steam injection heaters.

C:P2.6.text: Kadant’s wide range of doctoring, cleaning, and filtration systems and related consumables are used in process industries worldwide. These products include doctor blades and holders, roll cleaning blades and holders, spray nozzles, oscillating showers, and fabric and belt cleaning systems.
